items.condition: A claimed decisive transition state lacks one intended imaginary mode or endpoint/connectivity evidence.
The two reported channel barriers use incompatible or unidentified reference states/thermochemical conventions.
An open-shell-singlet or triplet assignment is used without spin diagnostics, or an unstable wavefunction is treated as validated.
The reported sign convention is reversed, candidate identities are ambiguous, or the [4+2] and [2+2] barriers cannot be uniquely associated with their channels.
A bounded-failure submission fabricates a barrier/preference or omits the attempted coverage and missing validation.
